optionsNote: Volumes, mute, graphics quality, language, controls, reduced motion, high contrast and text size are in the StarHermit Options.
hostedSignIn: Sign in with StarHermit to host or join a table.
hostedRecorded: result recorded by the StarHermit server
awayOffline: {name} is away — the AI plays their turns.
termsRequiredShort: Accept StarHermit's updated terms to play online — use Back to StarHermit.
modeLearnText: Interactive lessons, one rule at a time.
modeDailyText: One shared seed per UTC day.
challengesText: Fixed seeds, fixed rules — comparable scores. No undo.
practiceNote: Practice is unranked. Undo and hints are available.
hostedText: Host a private table or join one with a code. The StarHermit server deals, checks every move and plays the empty seats. If you drop out, the AI plays your turns until you are back.
webglFallback: 3D view is unavailable in this browser. The full game is playable with the card list below.
goalText: Be the first to empty your hand. You score the points left in every rival's hand.
matchingText: Play a card that matches the top discard by suit or rank.
eightsText: Play an 8 on anything, then declare the suit the next player must match. Eights left in hand cost 50 points.
drawingText: If you can't play, draw from the stock — up to 3 cards, then your turn passes.
helpTap: Tap a highlighted card to play it; tap Draw to take cards.
fairText: Every deal comes from a visible seed. Identical seeds and moves replay identically.
cantPlay: Can't play {card}: must match {suit} or rank {rank}, or play an 8.
declarePrompt: You played an 8. Declare a suit.
yourTurnDraw: Your turn. No playable cards — draw.
err_illegal: must match suit or rank, or play an 8
err_notInHand: that card is not in your hand
hostedUnavailable: Online tables aren't available for this launch. Practice, Journey, Daily and Challenges are fully playable.
disconnectedLocal: Disconnected. Rejoin with your table code to resume.
lobbyStatus: {n} seated · host starts the round; empty seats are filled by AI.
createFailed: Couldn't create a table. Try again.
joinFailed: Couldn't join the table. Try again.
hostLeft: The host left — the table is closed.
cantSeat: Couldn't take a seat at this table.
tablesUnavailable: Online tables are unavailable right now — try again later. Solo modes are fully playable.
recordsLine: Rounds played: {played} · won: {won} · best score: {best} · best streak: {streak}
wipeConfirm: Erase all saved progress, achievements, and settings?
challenges.c-sprint.1: Win in 24 moves or fewer against two rivals.
challenges.c-longhaul.1: Full hands of nine, three sharp rivals.
challenges.c-duel.1: One rival, expert play, no undo.
challenges.c-minimal.1: Tiny hands of four. Every card matters.
tutorial.t-match.1: Play a card that matches the top card's suit or rank. Use ← → to choose, Enter to play — or tap a highlighted card.
tutorial.t-eight.1: An 8 can be played on anything. After playing one, declare the suit the next player must match.
tutorial.t-draw.1: No matching card? Press D or the Draw button to take from the stock (up to 3, then you pass).
tutorial.t-win.1: First player with no cards wins the round and scores the points left in every rival's hand. Eights are worth 50 — shed them early!
achievements.eight_master.1: Win a round in which you played at least three eights.
achievements.streak_3.1: Win three rounds in a row.
achievements.daily_7.1: Play the daily challenge on 7 different days.
achievements.pacifist.1: Win a round with zero invalid actions and no hints.
